# Original media intake fixtures

These are unchanged `docs/media/plate-car.jpg`, `social-card.png` and
`off-vs-on.mp4` from `ruashots/open-h3-ir` commit
`fd031e136ae3d89147324c0d1b2aa65e838c21f5`, used by the original
`tests/test_file_facts.py`. `manifest.json` records each original path, SHA-256
and byte length; native tests additionally pin the manifest hash.

inputs. No expected model prose or native output is manufactured from them.
